column1: # Applied symbol names for vita-2048-eu-v104 eboot.elf (image base 0x81000000).
# The evidence lives in the page named in the last column; this file exists so
# the names can be re-applied to a fresh Ghidra database without hand-editing.
# Run `just apply-names` after importing eboot.elf. See ADR-0005: the pages are
# the record of truth, and scripts/apply-ghidra-names.py checks that every row
# here still appears in its evidence page before it renames anything.
# kind is `function` or `data`. Confidence below 70 gets a `_q` suffix applied,
# below 50 is skipped. Recovered library and import symbols keep their real
# names rather than the project's Subsystem_VerbNoun scheme.
# The chase-camera rig and the craft scale it applies (2026-10-01).
# The weapon callout, glyph row, forced-craft quads and trophy textures (2026-10-05).
# Where a race's particle effect files are read from (2026-10-05).
# Which mode a 2048 race is, and which side of the magstrip split it lands on (2026-10-05, magstrip-2048-pob lane).
# Where 2048 creates fragment programs (2026-10-05, omega-2048-materials lane).
# Crossfade system and the SCREAM name hash (2026-10-05, v2048-engine lane).
# The original opponent driver, mapped against HD's and measured on Vita3K (2026-10-12, orig-ai-2048 lane).
